title: Only Fools and Horses Charity Quiz on Friday 25 September
preheader: £3 cash entry · every entry fee donated to Macmillan · four themed rounds · teams up to six

image.alt: Only Fools and Horses charity quiz artwork for The Anchor and Stanwell Moor Community Wellbeing Garden, in aid of Macmillan Cancer Support

data.headline: Lovely jubbly. It’s quiz night for a brilliant cause.
body: We are joining forces with the Stanwell Moor Community Wellbeing Garden for an Only Fools and Horses themed quiz in aid of Macmillan Cancer Support. Every penny from the £3 entry fee will be donated.

data.label: Every entry fee donated.
data.body: All prizes are funded separately, so the full £3 entry fee from every player goes to Macmillan Cancer Support.

rows.label: Donation
rows.value: 100% of quiz entry fees to Macmillan Cancer Support

data.heading: He who dares, quizzes
body: Expect four themed rounds covering characters, storylines, famous quotes, Peckham adventures and the deeper details proper fans remember. There is also a quick interactive middle game, spot prizes and a £25 bar voucher for first place.
Dress-up is welcome, dinner is available from 4pm to 9pm, and the aim is a feel-good Friday night that raises as much as possible for Macmillan.
This is an independently organised fundraiser and themed fan quiz. It is not an official Only Fools and Horses event.

data.body: Get your team together and book ahead for a Friday night of classic moments, big laughs and a brilliant cause.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, or because you said you would like to hear from us. That may have been a while ago now, and we are glad you are still with us.
